payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all combinations of removals from left/right/top/bottom ends of sorted centers to find minimal bounding box area, constrained by k allowed removals.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tries all (l,r,u,d) with l+r<=k and u+d<=k, checking distinct removed indices. This is a brute-force search, not a greedy strategy.
